name: codex-workbuddy-bridge
description: Connect the models you are signed in to in the WorkBuddy AI desktop app to Codex (CLI and desktop app), with no OpenAI subscription or Codex plan required.

interface.shortDescription: Drive Codex with WorkBuddy desktop models
interface.longDescription: Turns the models you are signed in to in the WorkBuddy AI desktop app into the Codex model source: a local proxy decrypts the desktop session, translates the Responses API into the upstream Chat Completions format, and generates the model picker catalog. Includes the hy3 / deepseek-v4.1-flash / step-5-preview tiers that measured 0 credits, plus the /wbbridge-setup one-shot installer and the /wbbridge-status self-check.
